# The UAE Wealth Dashboard

> Free interactive tool and dataset showing where any salary or net worth ranks among the ~11 million residents of the United Arab Emirates. Covers income percentiles, wealth distribution, salary benchmarks for 837 roles, and wealth by emirate. Data compiled 2026-08-04 from the World Inequality Database, UBS Global Wealth Report, UAE Federal Competitiveness & Statistics Centre, Henley & Partners and published recruiter salary guides.

Licence: figures may be cited with attribution to The UAE Wealth Dashboard (https://wealthdashboarduae.com).

## Key figures (gross monthly, AED, unless stated)

- Median salary, all UAE workers (~9.2M): AED 3,662
- Mean salary, all UAE workers: AED 9,490
- Median salary, official household-survey frame (~5.5M): AED 8,926
- Mean salary, household-survey frame: AED 15,234
- Median salary, white-collar professionals (~2.0M): AED 20,010
- Median household income (~2.4M households): AED 19,720
- Share of all UAE workers earning under AED 5,000/month: about 60%
- Top 10% of all workers threshold: AED 21,674
- Top 1% of all workers threshold: AED 87,333
- Median net worth per adult (WID-based model): AED 337,549
- Top 1% net worth threshold: AED 14,419,108 ($3,926,238)
- UAE wealth Gini: 0.82 — highest in the world (UBS 2026)
- USD millionaires in the UAE: ~183,000 (UBS GWR 2026)
- USD millionaires in Dubai: 81,200; centi-millionaires 237; billionaires 20 (Henley, end-2024)
- Net millionaire migration to the UAE 2025: +9,800, world's highest for a fourth year
- Estimated household wealth per adult: Dubai $243,000, Abu Dhabi $123,000, Sharjah $83,000
- GDP per capita 2023: Abu Dhabi $65,700, Dubai $44,600, Sharjah $32,100
- No personal income tax on salaries; Emirati private-sector minimum wage AED 6,000/month from Jan 2026

## Important methodological note

UAE salary statistics disagree because they describe different populations. The Labour Force Survey median (~AED 10,000) covers workers in conventional households; Wage Protection System data shows over 60% of all workers earn under AED 5,000. Household surveys do not reach labour camps and collective accommodation. Any citation should state which population the figure describes.
